            statementsService -> ledgerDatabase "reads"

            batchScheduler -> ledgerDatabase "reads and writes"

input.dsl:
workspace "Bank Portal" "A C4 model of the online banking platform" {

    model {

        customer = person "Bank Customer" "Manages their accounts, moves money, and tracks their activity"

        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "Routes card authorisations"
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "Performs credit checks"

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform, owned and operated by our company" {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app"
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records"
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers"
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers"
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards"
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts"
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers"
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements"
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits"
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts"
            ledgerDatabase = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement"
            customerDatabase = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs"

            customer -> webPortal "manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"
            customer -> mobileAppBackend "manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"

            webPortal -> accountService "uses"
            webPortal -> transactionService "uses"
            webPortal -> paymentService "uses"
            webPortal -> cardService "uses"
            webPortal -> statementsService "uses"
            webPortal -> directDebitService "uses"

            mobileAppBackend -> accountService "uses"
            mobileAppBackend -> transactionService "uses"
            mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "uses"
            mobileAppBackend -> cardService "uses"
            mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "uses"
            mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "uses"

            transactionService -> ledgerDatabase "updates"
            transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "scores transactions"
            transactionService -> eventQueue "publishes events"

            notificationService -> eventQueue "consumes events"

            statementsService -> ledgerDatabase "reads"
            statementsService -> documentStore "writes"

            batchScheduler -> ledgerDatabase "reads and writes"
            batchScheduler -> customerDatabase "reads and writes"

            paymentService -> cardService "uses"
            paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "uses"
            paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations"

            onboardingService -> customerDatabase "reads"
            onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks"
        }
    }
}
